dataset.datasetnotes:
Information on collectors of the Hongve surface samples was not available.  However, sampling would have involved or been supervised by Ronald Davis and / or Stephen Norton.  Dates samples taken and water depths at which samples were taken were also not available.  Note:  See data in Norton et al 1981 for more info on the Hongve-sampled lakes.

Diatom nomenclature is based in the PIRLA taxonomy, as documented in the PIRLA Diatom Iconograph and Camburn and Charles (2000).

Microscope slides of diatoms from most sites are in the Academy of Natural Sciences Diatom Herbarium.
This dataset was originally uploaded to the Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University constituent database, which was merged into the Diatom Paleolimnology Data Cooperative (DPDC) constituent database in July 2026.
